description: An eight-bit counter: each trigger adds or subtracts the number set by the bit inputs, and the count comes back out as eight bits

params.text: Adds the step to the count once per press
Subtracts the step from the count once per press
Flips the state of that bit before the step is worked out, shown by the lamp; bit 1 starts flipped, so an untouched module steps by 1

inputs.text: Sets that bit of the step, counted as 1 at 1V or more; bit 1 is worth 1 and bit 8 is worth 128
A rising gate here adds the step to the count
A rising gate here subtracts the step from the count
A rising gate here sets the count to zero
Feeds all eight step bits from one polyphonic cable, channel 1 as bit 1; a cable in a numbered jack takes over that bit

outputs.text: That bit of the count, 10V when the bit is 1; the count runs 0 to 255 and wraps round
All eight bits of the count on one polyphonic cable, bit 1 on channel 1
